speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have a psychiatric condition and have developed a new movement disorder; to help you, I need to ask a few questions. How long have you been experiencing these movement symptoms, and do you take any medication for your mental health?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Acute Dystonia (secondary to Risperidone).

I see you were started on risperidone two months ago for schizophrenia, which explains the movement disorder. To confirm this is an acute dystonic reaction rather than tardive dyskinesia or parkinsonism, when exactly did these movements begin relative to starting the medication, and can you describe the specific type of movement you are experiencing?
